summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Kamada Ltd., a foreign private issuer, to disclose FDA approval of a new in-house rabies virus neutralization testing laboratory (RFFIT). The filing describes an operational expansion for quality control testing of its products KEDRAB and KAMRAB, with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or capital event. There are no deal terms, board decisions, or structural changes to the company. The filing is purely a business update and does not constitute a special-situation event under the defined categories.
